Class SuperItem

java.lang.Object
org.redcape.model.object.items.SuperItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
Item
Direct Known Subclasses:
CampItem, EndDoor, FoodItem, KeyBladeItem, KeyItem, KeyRingItem, PotionItem
public class SuperItem extends Object implements Item
SuperItem class representing an item in the game.

This class implements the Item interface and provides the basic structure and behavior of an item in the game.
